lore: A short book that knows legacy names, claims and other tweaks.
use: The Simple Tweaks Guide explains legacy names, claims and other tweaks. Craft it shapeless from a book and a crafting table.
secret: Its chapters unlock as the matching recipes land in your recipe book. Nothing is consumed.

lore: A deed from an older world, still stamped with its first owner.
use: A legacy item without a recipe, kept for existing worlds or /give. Stacks to 16. Using it claims the chunk you stand in, like /claim create.
secret: Its original texture and custom data are kept exactly, so an old deed still works after an update.
